execution_notes: M4 session S ran 14:48:26-14:49:38 PDT, after da8e6a00 was confirmed on GitHub (14:39:37). Every process started on an idle Mac mini: no process of any user at >= 20 % CPU, no python process at >= 1 % CPU, 1-min load < 3 (load_S.log, checked before each process and logged after it). The core-check loop took 0.049-0.053 s in all 6 processes (performance-core speed). One warm-up pass of sector Relay-BP over 1,000 test shots (warmup_S.csv).

The idle check written here said 'no python process'. A system Python 3.9 (Command Line Tools) idle since boot (0.0 % CPU, up 44 h) kept it false for 8 minutes, so the first try (mac_S_try1.log) was stopped before any process ran and the check was narrowed to no python process at >= 1 % CPU; the other conditions are unchanged (mac_S.sh).

Brief background activity seen in the after-process lines: WebKit at 66.8 % CPU after the warm-up and Spotlight (mds_stores 61.8 %) after BB72-2S process 3, whose mean time per routed shot is 1 % above the other two and is the counted (slowest) one; each time the check waited 15 s before the next process.
